{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation additions in doc/design/ and doc/private-broadcast.md accompany the implementation rather than serving as the primary change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Code PRs that include design notes and documentation belong to the functional area rather than docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only incidentally without altering the kernel API, boundary, or extraction goals.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental references in kernel files do not make a PR part of libbitcoinkernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label, deletes extensive private broadcast special-casing from src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp, and reimplements the transport and broadcast state machine under src/privbcast.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "The rewrite addresses severe privacy leaks and node crash hazards from adversarial inputs in transaction broadcast. The prior implementation coupled private broadcast directly to node networking state in `CConnman` and `PeerManager`, risking 'privacy leaks via recipient interactions, node mempool feedback, or adversarial inputs crashing the node'; transaction origin privacy and attack resistance are primary concerns in P2P."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds `getprivatebroadcastinfo` and `abortprivatebroadcast` commands, but only to expose the underlying private broadcast functionality.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "RPC endpoints that merely expose behavior belonging to another area are governed by that area rather than RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Fuzz harnesses and functional test framework additions in test/functional/test_framework/privbcast.py specifically test the private broadcast subsystem.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning behavior of a specific P2P subsystem belong to that area rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/init.cpp solely wire up startup and shutdown for the private broadcast worker.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup hook wiring for a specific subsystem does not constitute shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter consensus, block connection, chainstate, or validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Validation rules and invariants are not affected by transaction relay transport isolation."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
